system.description:
The earth opens beneath a creature within 60' to swallow it whole. The Worm does not like to be called.
,
Rituals are cast outside combat and cost no ember. Test Sanity against the DR of the ritual's heading.

outcomes.success: The creature takes 3d10 damage. If this reduces it to 0 HP, it is consumed utterly; no body remains to be raised.
outcomes.ruin: The Worm takes you instead: test Agility DR20 or die. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
